description: This file defines the Twig\Markup class, which is used to mark string content as safe within the Twig templating engine. It implements interfaces for counting, JSON serialization, and string representation, and manages content and charset information.

classes.name: Twig\Markup
classes.description: A class used to mark string content as safe for rendering in Twig templates. Contains content and charset, and implements Countable, JsonSerializable, and Stringable interfaces.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the content and charset.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns the content as a string.

methods.name: getCharset
methods.description: Returns the charset of the content.

methods.name: count
methods.description: Returns the length of the content in the specified charset.

methods.name: jsonSerialize
methods.description: Serializes the content for JSON encoding.
